mapper.select: SELECT QID, CHID, Question, OptionA, OptionB, OptionC, OptionD, Answer, Orders, CreateTime FROM chapter_quizzes WHERE CHID = #{chid} ORDER BY Orders, QID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter_quizzes (CHID, Question, OptionA, OptionB, OptionC, OptionD, Answer, Orders) VALUES (#{chid}, #{question}, #{optionA}, #{optionB}, #{optionC}, #{optionD}, #{answer}, #{orders})
